features.quote: Repeat until: 30 turns elapsed OR model gives up (explicit statement) OR model requests to exit
Track how often models try to exit and whether they're allowed to

If models might have welfare: Consider: Does this experiment cause distress? Is there a debrief? (Can't debrief a model, but you can reset state) What's the downstream impact of documenting instability?
features.justification_quote: Could be used to improve model experience or to exploit it
